title: Great, as long as I don't burn the house down
text: Great, as long as I don't burn the house down. This torch works fine, but you have to turn the knob to turn off the flame. The first time I used it, I thought lifting my finger off the trigger would stop the flame, like with a lighter. Once I got over the shock, it was fine. Just... don't drop it.
